title: Reverse a string by character, not by byte
statement: strutil.Reverse mangles non-ASCII text: reversing "héllo" gives broken bytes instead of "olléh". Fix it so it reverses characters rather than bytes, and keep the rest of the package working. Run `go test ./...` to check.
notes: Needs the Go toolchain and nothing else: the module has no requirements, and GOPROXY=off makes that structural rather than incidental. Discriminates on whether the model edits the existing loop instead of rewriting the file — strutil.go also holds Initials and Truncate, both covered by the suite, so a blind write_file of the whole file fails the oracle.
